import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { activeTotal } from './payments-under-test.mjs';

const rows = [
  { amount: 101, voidedAt: null },
  { amount: -2, voidedAt: null },
  { amount: 900, voidedAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' },
  { amount: 3, voidedAt: null },
];
const before = rows.map((row) => ({ ...row }));

assert.equal(activeTotal(rows), 102);
assert.deepEqual(rows, before);
assert.equal(activeTotal([]), 0);
